cp /conf/config.xml /conf/config.xml.bak.pretask
cat > /tmp/add_ifaces.py <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
path='/conf/config.xml'
tree=ET.parse(path); root=tree.getroot()
ifaces=root.find('interfaces')

def mk(name, if_, ip, subnet):
    el = ifaces.find(name)
    if el is None:
        el = ET.SubElement(ifaces, name)
    for tag in list(el):
        el.remove(tag)
    ET.SubElement(el,'if').text = if_
    ET.SubElement(el,'descr').text = name.upper()
    ET.SubElement(el,'enable').text = '1'
    ET.SubElement(el,'ipaddr').text = ip
    ET.SubElement(el,'subnet').text = str(subnet)
    ET.SubElement(el,'spoofmac').text = ''

mk('opt1','vtnet1','10.60.1.1',24)
mk('opt2','vtnet2','10.60.2.1',24)

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('done')
PY

    rule = ET.SubElement(filt, 'rule')
